title: Private Family Walking Tour in Quebec Old Town Heritage
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This private walking tour invites families to explore Quebec City’s historic heart. You wander ancient streets and medieval alleyways shaped centuries before the United States existed. At Place Royale, colonial architecture and cultural heritage come alive. Discover murals depicting the city’s classical evolution. Stroll along cobblestone streets while hearing echoes of past civilizations. Explore charming squares, sense the UNESCO Heritage atmosphere, and experience the city’s living traditions. Children and adults alike feel the depth of history around every corner. End with sweeping views from the ramparts, embracing the legacy and cultural richness of Old Quebec.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience
